choices.label: Dismiss
choices.outcome: Moves the item to operator-dismissed.json; it returns in the next edition if it re-fires.

choices.label: Park
choices.outcome: Parks the item and files your guidance note (required).

choices.label: Expire
choices.outcome: Archives the item as stale; it returns only if it re-fires.

choices.label: Suppress
choices.outcome: Suppresses this identity so repeated copies stay collapsed.

choices.label: Acknowledge
choices.outcome: Records the item acknowledged with an optional note.

articles.headline: Sample wire story: storm system moves across the Atlantic
articles.deck: A deep low pressure system is tracking eastward. Forecasters expect coastal gales by Tuesday.
body: A deep low pressure system is tracking eastward toward the continent.
Forecasters expect coastal gales and heavy rain by Tuesday.

ghost.text: The storm is the sort of fact that arrives without permission and cannot be argued with; the forecasters do their careful arithmetic, the coastal towns board their windows, and the low pressure system grinds eastward all the same, indifferent to every ledger kept against it.
